preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 1000.
The number of flights m must be between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai < bi <= n for ai, bi in flights)
preconditions.description: Each flight must be from a city ai to a city bi where ai is less than bi and both are within the range of city numbers.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to adjust flight durations, output 'No'; otherwise, output 'Yes' followed by m integers representing the new durations.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(duration) <= 2 for duration in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each flight duration must be either 1 or 2 hours.

postconditions.expression: all(trip_time == trip_time for trip_time in trip_times)
postconditions.description: All trips from city 1 to city n must take the same amount of time.
